## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm build` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] `founderos verify` passes (if skills changed)
- [ ] Docs updated (if behavior changed)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`

## For new / changed skills

- [ ] `SKILL.md` has all required frontmatter (`name`, `description`, `version`, `category`, `tools`)
- [ ] `SKILL.md` has all 13 required sections
- [ ] Includes at least one **realistic** example (no lorem ipsum)
- [ ] A matching example was added/updated under `examples/`
